description.zh:
使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：50。
description.en:
The maximum number of results to be returned from a single query when the NextToken parameter is used in the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 50.

description.zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.
The ID of the AI task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-ai-task-events --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000w== --max-results 50 --task-id t-asasas00000 --region cn-hangzhou
